title: Dheemi Si Yaad
prompt: Hindi lo-fi Indian R&B-soul ballad with mellow tabla, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, warm sub bass and soft analog pads, tender and aching with late-night longing, intimate tape-warm bedroom production, warm expressive male playback vocal with breathy falsetto, hazy velvety timbre
lyrics:
[Intro]
(hmm... hmm...)
Raat dhali, tu yaad aayi

[Verse]
Khidki pe baarish ki boond
Kamra mera sunsaan sa
Chai bhi thandi ho gayi
Dil dhoonde tera pata

[Pre-Chorus]
Phone ki roshni jaagi
Naam tera ek baar

[Chorus]
Dheemi si yaad jaise dhuaan (harmonies)
Haule se mujhe jala gayi
Thehri hui har ek saans
Teri kami yahaan reh gayi

[Verse 2]
Galiyon mein woh hansi teri
Deewaron pe likhi hui
Neend bhi mujhse rooth gayi
Raaton ko kar bekhabar

[Bridge]
[falsetto]
Lautega kya tu phir kabhi
Ya SIRF ek sapna bani
Main intezaar ki nadi (ad-lib)
Behti rahungi har ghadi

[Outro]
[melancholic]
Dheemi si yaad... reh gayi
(reh gayi... reh gayi...)
